claim.statement: GitLab's current documentation says GitLab.com flows can use enabled-by-default hosted runners or a user-managed runner; a user-managed flow runner needs the gitlab--duo tag and a Docker-image-capable executor, while the shell executor is unsupported.

values: project or subgroup runner where restrictions permit

limitations: Hosted and user-managed runners have different ownership, networking and isolation boundaries.
A configured runner is not necessarily sandboxed; sandbox support depends on its image and privileged configuration.
unknowns: The runner provider, runner version, executor, image, tag scope, network policy and ephemeral-state behavior are unknown.
Offering-specific hosted-runner availability beyond the explicit GitLab.com statement is unresolved.

relationships.note: Runner eligibility and executor support do not establish sandbox or network isolation; those depend on separate security configuration.
